listing.title: JH Gallery Handmade Raja Rani Tealight Holders - Multicolour, Pack of 2
listing.description: A pack of two handmade Raja–Rani tealight holders created by JH Gallery artisans in Rajasthan. Each multicolour tabletop piece combines cloth-bodied puppets, an umbrella-style canopy and a decorated recycled base with a holder for a standard tealight or small wax diya. Hand-painted details may vary slightly between pieces. Suitable for pooja spaces, festive displays, centre tables and return gifting. Tealights are not promised as included.
listing.careInstructions: Wipe with a dry cloth or remove dust with a blower. Allow the holder to cool before moving it.
listing.safetyInformation: Do not leave a burning flame unattended. Allow the holder to cool before moving it. An LED tealight may be used where an open flame is not wanted.
listing.returnConditions: Returns or exchanges are accepted within 10 days of delivery under the standard Hastabazaar return policy.

verifiedFacts.packageContents: Two Raja-Rani tealight holders; tealight/LED inclusion is not confirmed
